sections: Listen for the rules that appear when you try to stop: I can rest after I finish this, I have not done enough yet, or other people are working harder. Writing those rules down makes them easier to examine instead of obeying automatically.

If a whole day off feels impossible, begin smaller. Sit with a drink without opening your phone, leave one walk untracked, or close the laptop at the time you planned. Repeated small pauses teach your mind that stopping is safe.
